lessons.title: Hello and goodbye
objectives: Use Hello, Hi, and Goodbye in short exchanges.
Use social greetings in one short, clear everyday exchange.

content_sections.title: Language focus
content_sections.body: In lesson 1: social greetings, notice this model: Hello, I am Lan. Keep the word order short and make the meaning clear.

content_sections.title: Everyday context
content_sections.body: Read the original mini-context for lesson 1: social greetings: 'Hello, I am Lan.' Say which words carry the main information.

exercises.prompt: Choose the exact model sentence for lesson 1: social greetings.
options: No detail is provided in Hello and goodbye.
A different routine appears in Hello and goodbye.

exercises.prompt: Match the two lesson 1: social greetings cues with their meanings.

pairs.left: Target phrase in Hello and goodbye

pairs.right: Use Hello, Hi, and Goodbye in short exchanges.

exercises.prompt: Give your own short speaking response for lesson 1: social greetings; use the target but do not copy the model.

criteria: The response clearly addresses social greetings in lesson 1.
The response uses the allocated Hello and goodbye target intelligibly.

listening.instruction: Listen to the tutor read the lesson 1: social greetings transcript once. Answer one question before seeing the text.
listening.goal: Identify one explicit detail about social greetings.
listening.question: What is the speaker's name?
constraints: Do not reveal the transcript before the learner answers.
Ask exactly one comprehension question.
Use only the supplied project-authored transcript.

speaking.instruction: Take the learner role in a two-turn exchange about social greetings in lesson 1; respond with one or two short sentences.
speaking.goal: Use the social greetings language focus intelligibly.
constraints: Use at most two tutor turns.
Correct only one blocking error after the response.

pronunciation.instruction: Read the target words for lesson 1: social greetings aloud, then compare clear final sounds and stress.
pronunciation.goal: Produce the selected social greetings words clearly.
constraints: Assess pronunciation only when learner audio is available.
Return NOT_ASSESSED when no audio is supplied.

writing.instruction: Write a two-line greeting. For lesson 1: social greetings, submit your draft before receiving two brief improvement points.
writing.goal: Write a short A1 response about social greetings.
constraints: Wait for the learner draft before giving feedback.
Do not replace the learner draft with a complete rewritten answer.
